rec.name: Cart Line-Item Promo Banner (Free Gift Bar)

what.text: A configurable promo strip in the cart (drawer) that appears directly under a line item when that item's quantity is below a set threshold. It shows a short message with an optional icon, for example 'Order 2 and get an extra 10% off!'. It is managed under Theme settings > 'Cart Promo Banner'. The ticket is titled 'Free Gift Bar', but the settings and example copy show a quantity-discount nudge rather than a gift. The ticket has no description, so the spec is reconstructed from comments and screenshots.

why.text: It gives a quantity-based incentive at the moment of purchase, which raises units per order and AOV. A concrete, low-effort goal ('add one more, get 10% off') uses goal-gradient and loss-aversion effects. Placing it under the item keeps the message in context. The soft background keeps it noticeable without competing with the checkout CTA.

how.text: Add a 'Cart Promo Banner' group to the theme settings (settings_schema) with: Enable toggle, Quantity (number), Text (rich text), Icon (inline SVG code), Text color, Background color. In the cart/drawer line-item loop, render the banner when the toggle is on and item.quantity < the configured Quantity. The check is per line item, NOT against the total cart quantity. A bundle line item with quantity 1 therefore still shows the banner when the threshold is 4. The Enable toggle (added Aug 2025) hides the whole banner, including the icon, when it is off. Previously, clearing the text left the empty box and icon visible, as seen in the first screenshot.

items: Quantity threshold (banner shows when a line item's quantity is below this)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are evident. It relies on theme settings plus custom Liquid/JS in the cart line-item template. It is shown in a cart drawer that also has a free-shipping progress bar and an upsell list ('Passt perfekt dazu'). Whether it works on a full cart page and any discount configuration are not specified. The 10% discount must exist separately (automatic discount or code), and this is an inference.

items: Units per order / items per line
Share of cart sessions where the banner is shown
Rate of quantity increases on bannered line items
